name: Slug
summary: Flat vector soft yellow-olive garden slug with a mantle bump and eye stalks; slowly stretches as it crawls.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 220 px long at s = 1

params.name: pose
params.note: idle = slow eye-stalk sway; crawl = body stretches in a slow wave and eye stalks swing

params.name: vx
params.note: px per frame drift (use a small value, e.g. 0.5, for a slow crawl)

author: krakujs
